android.extraProguardRules:
# OkHttp (via React Native networking) references optional TLS providers that are
# never on the runtime classpath. AGP 8 escalates the missing-class warning to a
# build failure, so they are silenced explicitly rather than left to chance.
-dontwarn org.conscrypt.**
-dontwarn org.bouncycastle.**
-dontwarn org.openjsse.**

# Hermes + Expo module registries resolve these through JNI/reflection, so R8
# cannot see the call sites and would otherwise strip them.
-keepclasseswithmembernames class * { native <methods>; }

extra._comment_api: Production Laravel API on its own subdomain (Cloudflare-proxied). As of this build the domain answers HTTP 525 (Cloudflare cannot TLS-handshake the origin) — a hosting-side problem, not something this app can work around. Verify with `curl -I https://soulcoffee.rafancloud.com/api/v1/auth/login` before shipping a build that assumes this is live. For local development against Laragon use http://10.0.2.2:8000/api/v1 (Android emulator) or http://<LAN-IP>:8000/api/v1 (physical device), then rebuild.
extra._comment_reverb: reverbAppKey must match REVERB_APP_KEY in the backend's .env on this host — it was never confirmed against a live server (see _comment_api) and is still the placeholder used for local Laragon testing. If the host can't keep `php artisan reverb:start` alive under supervisor/systemd, the socket will never connect and useRealtime() permanently falls back to a 10s refetch — that degrades gracefully, but requirement 3 (true realtime) is only met when Reverb is actually kept running.
extra._comment_demoMode: false: every screen now calls the real Laravel API at apiBaseUrl instead of src/features/demo/router.ts's in-memory fixtures. DemoBanner and the role-switcher (loginAsDemoRole) are gone from the UI — real accounts must exist in the backend's users table with is_active=1. Flip back to true only for an offline standalone demo build; see README's "Real backend" section for the wire-format gaps that src/lib/mappers.ts papers over.
